    id                    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    scenario_id           BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES scenarios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id               BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    session_id            BIGINT REFERENCES game_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    
    -- 평가 내용

    difficulty            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (difficulty BETWEEN 1 AND 5),

    updated_at            TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    
    UNIQUE(scenario_id, user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_reviews_scenario_id ON reviews(scenario_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE scenario_rankings (
    id                    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    scenario_id           BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES scenarios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
user_id               BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

session_id            BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    
    -- 랭킹 정보
    score                 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    clear_time            BIGINT NOT NULL,                                -- 클리어 시간 (초)
    rank_grade            VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL,                            -- S, A, B, C, F
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
